name: Nishimagome
tagline: A seat every morning, and rent about 40% below central Tokyo.
summary: Nishimagome is the terminus of the Toei Asakusa Line, which means you get a seat on every morning train — a genuine daily benefit in Tokyo. It is a calm residential part of Ota Ward, and rent is clearly cheaper than other stations with a comparable commute. The trade-off is a single line, so there is no easy alternative when it stops.
goodFor: People who want to sit down on the way to work
People who want a sub-30-minute commute at a lower rent
notFor: People who want restaurant and nightlife options nearby
People who need a backup line during service disruptions
People who want shops right at the station
residentComment: The station is not well known, and the rent reflects that honestly. Living at a terminus matters more than it sounds on paper. The catch is that going out for dinner or drinks usually means taking the train somewhere else.
